name: Frostmane Hold
summary: Frostmane trolls raid from the cliffs south of Gnomeregan in western Dun Morogh. The Ironforge Guard watches their camp and caverns as the raiders press into dwarven lands.

sections.title: A Troll Bastion in the Snows
sections.body: In western Dun Morogh, Frostmane Hold cuts into cold cliffs. Rough structures stand outside its winding caves, where hideskinners and headhunters guard the tribe’s stronghold. From here, Frostmane raiders strike the valleys, threaten travelers on mountain passes, and test the defenses around Kharanos.

sections.title: A Thorn in Kharanos' Side
sections.body: Dwarven commanders in Kharanos fear the growing Frostmane force. Young mountaineers and adventurers scout the caverns and map their defenses. They thin the warbands before the tribe can gather for an organized assault on dwarven outposts.

faq.answer: Frostmane ice trolls live in the hold, including hunters, hideskinners, headhunters, chieftains, and raiders.
Frostmane Hold lies in western Dun Morogh, south of Gnomeregan’s industrial ruins and west of Kharanos.

faq.q: Why are the dwarves interested in this cave?
faq.answer: Dwarven leaders in Kharanos fear the Frostmane are gathering strength to raid settlements. They send scouts to map the caves and thin the trolls’ ranks.

faq.q: Are there troggs in Frostmane Hold?
faq.answer: No. Frostmane ice trolls occupy the hold. Troggs in Dun Morogh remain mainly in their own dens and the ruins of Gnomeregan.

angles.text: The Frostmane have contested Dun Morogh for centuries. As a mountaineer, you help clear Frostmane Hold and protect Ironforge’s snowy heartland.
South of Gnomeregan, Frostmane Hold is another dangerous front beside the embattled former gnome capital.
